title: SAIF-VERSE Update v1.0.7 — Dynamic Multi-Message Timeline & Bug Fixes
changelog:
🌸 What's New in v1.0.7:
• Fixed Discord 6000-character embed limit by automatically chunking activity logs across 2 to 3 separate messages
• Live dispatch progress in app: sends each message part sequentially with safe rate limit pacing
• 100% full screen unlock timestamps, zero truncation, complete session intervals
• Raw Activity_Timeline.txt text archive attached to the final message
• Cleaned offline queue management and fixed queuing errors
